training: one-layer 24-unit RNN from scratch, spell-balanced frame loss; 12 sampled iterations; 1024 windows; seed42; dropout0.15; L2 0.0001; clipped norm5
loss_weights: min(4,sqrt(10 seconds / observed spell duration)), floor0.5; direct known H/A boundary neighbourhood x1.5; unknown weight0; unknown-censored spells retain weight1 before boundary multiplier
boundary_head: team-invariant geometry/trajectory/RNN score changes, balanced logistic, train-only, 35 epochs, near-unknown target windows excluded
selection: highest mean clean/masked validation spellF1 subject to summed IoU0.5 false positives <=110% of previous European RNN and short pulse count <= reference+5; include unchanged previous model as fallback
test_policy: checksum only until candidate, baseline and comparators frozen; score once, no post-test tuning
metric_scope: conditional automatic provider-labelled H/A valid runs; no invented dead state
